title: URL shortener
summary: Turn long links into short ones and redirect a flood of clicks quickly.
context: A marketing platform wants its own link shortener. Each customer creates a handful of campaign links per day, but once a campaign goes live its short links are clicked far more often than they are created. A slow or failed redirect is a lost visit, so the read path is what matters most.
functionalRequirements: Create a short link for a long URL, optionally with a custom alias.
Redirect a short link to its long URL.
A link never changes after it is created, and it can expire.

requiredDependencies.name: a database for the URL mappings

assumptions: Peak traffic is 10,000 requests per second, 95% of them redirects.
Short codes are generated without coordination between instances, for example from pre-allocated ranges.
A redirect may serve a mapping that is a few seconds stale.
Expired links are cleaned up by a background job that is out of scope.
